Hello LAVAAN members

Assessing Measurement Reliability and Validity led by Centre for Applied Statistics Courses (CASC) (University College London) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar offers a comprehensive introduction to assessing measurement reliability and validity, essential for developing robust research instruments. It explores various statistical methods for evaluating both numeric and categorical outcomes, including Intraclass Correlation, Kappa, and internal consistency measures. Researchers employing lavaan for latent variable analysis can directly apply these foundational principles to critically evaluate their measurement models, thereby enhancing the quality and interpretability of their observed indicators and composite scales.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
